deployment: native 37x37 -> Gaussian blur 7x7 sigma1 -> bilinear align_corners=True -> stage mean -> softmax

frozen_inputs.D_rank: exact B2 D_rank ranking risk only
frozen_inputs.d_rank_bin: exact B2 10-bin within-image D_rank quantile bins
frozen_inputs.peer_rule: exact B1 same-image low-risk peer selection; no reselection in LOO
frozen_inputs.score_bin: exact B2 10-bin within-image m_bar quantile bins

gt_firewall: GT labels loaded only after complete GT-free cache finalization; labels annotate outcomes only

reliability_views.E_LOO: for each omitted peer, mean over stages using the remaining 7 frozen peers
reliability_views.E_stage: per-stage 1-cosine to normalized mean of the same frozen K=8 peers
reliability_views.certificate: strict > at all 3 stages and all 8 LOO views; equality abstains

selector.raw: unordered eligible pairs within cells; orient m_i < m_j and require E_nonlocal_i > E_nonlocal_j
selector.selected: sort certified by ascending m_j-m_i, ascending min patch ID, ascending max patch ID; greedily accept only disjoint pairs
